name: Dream11 T20 (legacy) – inferred from Kaggle IPL fantasy components
provenance: Reverse-engineered from Batting_FP/Bowling_FP/Fielding_FP arithmetic in the supplied Kaggle dataset (2008–2023) and checked by scripts/reconcile-kaggle.ts. Not confirmed against an official Dream11 rules archive for each season.
notes: Starting_11 is 4 for every Kaggle row (including impact substitutes), so the participation item is 4 points and is not added twice.

v1.1.0: reconciliation showed Kaggle labels award a 30-run bonus (highest-only with 50/100) and a 3-catch bonus, apply the strike-rate rule to every role, and exempt bowlers from the duck penalty. With inferred roles this reproduces 96.85% of 20,917 high-confidence Kaggle totals exactly (MAE 0.205). Residual mismatches come from inferred roles, run-out direct/indirect convention and fielding attribution differences.
Run-outs: Cricsheet does not mark direct hits. One named fielder is treated as direct; two or more named fielders each receive a non-direct credit.
Super Over events are excluded from all fantasy stats.
Role-based exemptions (duck, strike rate) use the player's role. When roles are inferred from history rather than the platform's listed role, these items can differ from official scores.
WPL scores computed with this config are reconstructed_unverified: no WPL Dream11 labels exist in the supplied data.
